Strategy Acquires 950 BTC, Bringing Total Holdings to 846,000 BTC Strategy announced that it acquired an additional 950 BTC and repurchased $174 million worth of STRC preferred stock. As of September 20, the company held 846,000 BTC and approximately $6.09 billion in USD assets. Previously disclosed figures showed holdings of 845,050 BTC at an average purchase price of $75,412 per coin, with a total acquisition cost of approximately $63.73 billion. During an earlier market downturn, Strategy’s unrealized losses on its Bitcoin holdings had exceeded $10 billion. Strive CEO Matt Cole said the company acquired 1,355 BTC for $107.7 million at an average price of $79,475 per coin, bringing its total holdings to 26,355 BTC. Strive began accepting warrant exercises last week and has received $21.2 million in gross proceeds. Including these funds, SATA accounts for 57.7% of the company's total capital raised. — link

Bitmine acquires 27,562 ETH, holdings near 5% supply target Bitmine (BMNR), the largest Ethereum treasury company, announced that it acquired 27,562 ETH over the past week. As of September 20, it held 5,983,940 ETH, representing 4.9% of the total ETH supply and reaching approximately 98% of its 5% accumulation target. Of its holdings, 5,067,309 ETH are staked, valued at approximately $13.6 billion at $2,688 per ETH. The company's combined crypto holdings, cash, marketable securities and other investments total approximately $17.1 billion, including $714 million in cash and marketable securities. — link

Coinbase Launches IPO Access for US Retail Investors, Starting With Oura Coinbase announced that eligible US retail investors can now request IPO share allocations directly through its app, starting with Oura’s IPO this week. Users can request shares at the offering price before public trading begins, though allocations may be filled in full, in part, or not at all.Investors who sell IPO shares within the first 30 days may be barred from participating in subsequent IPOs for 60 days. The service is provided by FINRA-registered broker-dealer Coinbase Capital Markets, with execution, clearing, and custody handled by Apex Clearing Corporation. — link

GMGN, One of the Largest Meme Coin Trading Platforms, Expands Into Perpetuals GMGN has launched the public beta of its perpetual trading product, co-founder Haze said. The platform currently supports markets including BTC/USDC, ETH/USDC, SNDK/USDC, SOL/USDC and ZEC/USDC, among others. Haze said liquidity is provided by third-party market makers, with fees set at 0.045% for takers and 0.015% for makers. GMGN also offers a mechanism providing a 3.5% annualized return on account funds and plans to introduce promotional trading credits for perpetuals. — link
